# `committee_report_reads`

**Committee-report acquisition checkpoints**

One row per package observed or inherited from this rollup's prior tables. Pending reads precede discovery under the declared body cap.

**Coverage.** Not a range. The committee-reports rollup's own processing state, including pending, refused, detail_refused and complete package reads. A complete hearing with zero cover links still has one checkpoint. *(measured 2026-09-20)*

- **Parquet file:** `committee_report_reads.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `package_id` | `VARCHAR` | GovInfo package ID and checkpoint identity. |
| `last_modified` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher timestamp requested, replaced by the acquired summary timestamp on success. |
| `outcome` | `VARCHAR` | pending, refused, detail_refused or complete; only complete permits an unchanged skip. |
| `rule_version` | `VARCHAR` | The package's CBO or hearing-link rule digest; a changed digest forces another read. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC time this rollup recorded the checkpoint. |
